defects.description: Glossary term 'Finding' translated as 'результаты' instead of the required 'вывод'.
The term 'safe value' is mistranslated as 'безопасного замечания'. 'Замечание' means 'remark' or 'note', whereas 'value' in this technical context must be 'значение'.
The term 'applied defaults' is mistranslated as 'применённые замечания по умолчанию'. 'Замечание' is incorrect for 'default value'.
